name: Kathal Korma

ingredients.name: young green jackfruit, drained and cubed

steps: Boil young jackfruit 12–15 minutes until just tender, then drain and pat dry. Soak cashews in 100 ml hot water and blend smooth.
Heat ghee and fry sliced onions 10 minutes until deep golden. Remove one-third for garnish; add cardamom, cinnamon and ginger-garlic paste to the rest, and cook 1 minute.
Add jackfruit and ground coriander, toss for 3 minutes so the edges take colour. Lower the heat.
Whisk yogurt with cashew paste and 60 ml water. Add it gradually, stirring constantly so it does not split. Add remaining water and salt; cover and simmer 12 minutes.
Finish with garam masala and reserved golden onions. Rest 5 minutes and serve the creamy korma with naan or rice.
tips: Use unripe jackfruit; ripe sweet jackfruit will not give the savoury korma texture.
notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.
